scope: Yahoo mail works again, from adding the account to reading, organizing and sending.

topics.title: Add a Yahoo account
details: Say Add account and choose Yahoo. Companion asks for your Yahoo address. Type it or say it.
Then type or paste your Yahoo app password and press Enter. Press Control+V to paste. Each letter is spoken as hidden.
Companion checks the password with Yahoo and tells you if it worked. If not, it says what to do.
Before, Yahoo setup froze with no speech, and you could not type or paste.

topics.title: Yahoo works like Gmail
details: Every email command now works the same way for Yahoo as for Gmail.
Delete and move now work for Yahoo. Deleted mail goes to Trash.
Say Go to Spam or Go to Junk to open spam. Yahoo calls this folder Bulk.
Mail you send from Yahoo is now kept in your Sent folder.

topics.title: Clear messages
details: If Yahoo stops accepting your app password, Companion says so. Make a new app password, then add the account again.
If sending fails, Companion says whether the message was sent.
Saying Yes, please, with a comma, now confirms a delete or move for any account.

topics.title: Thunderbird and other mail
details: Mail from a Thunderbird account can now be sent. Before, the send step refused it.
Names and subjects in other languages are now read the right way.

topics.title: Browser extension
details: The browser extension did not change. You do not need to reload it.
